articles.title: China yet to respond to India's request on GoPro camera recovered from Pahalgam attackers: NIA chief
articles.description: India is investigating a GoPro camera recovered from terrorists involved in the 2025 Pahalgam attack. The National Investigation Agency has yet to receive a response from Chinese authorities regarding the camera's origin. Forensic evidence has been gathered to trace the camera's supply chain to the terrorist group Lashkar-e-Taiba. The investigation focuses on the possibility of the camera being supplied by the Pakistan Army.

articles.title: FAA completes five-day aviation safety audit of India, outcome expected in months
articles.description: The FAA has finished its five-day evaluation of India's aviation safety oversight system, which began on November 16. The latest review follows increased scrutiny of India's aviation safety following several incidents.

articles.title: JPMorgan, Visa, Mastercard hit by cyber incidents; data of thousands of customers leaked
articles.description: JPMorgan Chase, Visa, and Mastercard have encountered cyber incidents with third-party service providers, leading to the potential exposure of customer data. Fortunately, these breaches did not compromise any payment systems or card details. Investigations are currently underway, with affected customers being notified directly by their financial institutions. This situation amplifies concerns regarding the security of data entrusted to external vendors, prompting regulatory inquiries into these matters.

articles.title: GTA 6 Launch: Germany Pays Workers To Play As $1 Billion Game Faces Labour Backlash And AI Threat
articles.description: GTA 6 has arrived with record-breaking hype, around 10 million pre-orders and production costs estimated at more than $1 billion. In Germany, some workers can even use paid educational leave to attend a three-day GTA 6 course featuring expert talks, workshops and gaming sessions. But behind the blockbuster launch lies a troubled video-game industry. Thousands of developers have lost their jobs since 2022, while Rockstar Games has faced criticism over long working hours, employee surveillance and alleged anti-union practices. As GTA 6 developers push for union recognition, the game’s launch also raises a bigger question: could artificial intelligence make massive, decade-long video-game projects a thing of the past?

articles.title: 'EFT which you can frame at home': Indian Railways has a message for passenger seeking a first Sleeper Class journey certificate after travelling without a ticket
articles.description: A passenger's request for a certificate marking his first-ever Sleeper Class train journey, despite travelling without a ticket, prompted a witty response from Indian Railways. The railway authority suggested he frame an Excess Fare Ticket (EFT) instead, leaving social media users amused by its savage comeback.
